description: Installed beside the No.1 building main gate in mid-March 2026 with engine mast and main rotor removed; the second UH-1J free-loaned to a civilian body after the Nippon Bunri University aircraft
Fitted with an IR light; installed mid-March 2026 with a dedication ceremony on 24 Mar 2026; it had been the walk-in exhibit at the Camp Kasumigaura open day of 24 May 2025
